# Orbit

> Project management for modern teams.

Orbit is a web-based project management tool built for small to medium teams. It provides kanban-style task boards, team collaboration with role-based access, AI-powered task generation and board summaries, and integrated billing.

## Core features

- **Kanban boards** — Drag-and-drop columns with configurable statuses. Tasks have titles, descriptions, assignees, priority levels (urgent/high/medium/low), and labels.
- **Team collaboration** — Invite team members by email. Roles: Owner, Admin, Member. Per-workspace member management.
- **AI features (Pro plan)** — AI task description generation, epic-to-subtask breakdown, and board summaries powered by streaming AI responses.
- **Workspaces** — Organise boards into named workspaces. Teams can have multiple workspaces.
- **Billing** — Three tiers managed through Stripe. Upgrade/downgrade at any time from billing settings.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Projects | Members | AI |
|------|-------|----------|---------|-----|
| Free | $0/mo | 1 | 1 (solo) | No |
| Lite | $9/mo | 10 | Up to 3 | No |
| Pro  | $19/mo | Unlimited | Unlimited | Yes |

All paid plans can be cancelled at any time. Existing data is never deleted when hitting plan limits — you are prompted to upgrade instead.

## Pages

- `/` — Landing page with product overview, features, and pricing
- `/pricing` — Full pricing page with plan details and FAQ
- `/sign-up` — Create an account (free, no credit card required)
- `/sign-in` — Sign in to an existing account
- `/onboarding` — First-run wizard to create a team and workspace
- `/w/[workspaceId]/b/[boardId]` — Kanban board view
- `/settings/billing` — Billing and usage dashboard
- `/settings/profile` — User profile and notification preferences

## Tech stack

Next.js (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (auth + PostgreSQL), Stripe (payments), Resend (email), Vercel AI SDK (streaming AI).
